name: Raw part loading
note: Stage 1: a recorded run of the Task agent where one had every field right, else a written reference dialogue (task_mode). Stage 2: a recorded run of the Layout agent (layout.run). Stage 3: coordination numbers from studio/data (final RobotATC campaign).

chat.text: A robot should load blanks from a table into a machine. The machine passes the part on by itself afterwards. A blank weighs 1.5 kg. The machine takes a new blank every 2 seconds.

chat.text: The machine accepts a new blank every 2 seconds, so the cycle time is 2 s. The machine itself is the only station time (2 s). The robot program has two moves: a carrying move from the table to the machine and an empty move back to the table, so 2 moves. Dividing the cycle time by the number of moves gives 1 s per move (2 s ÷ 2 = 1 s). (p. 225; p. 239). Please confirm.
